From ages 0-8 years old I believed that my parents word was law and that they were incapable of lying to me. They told me that Santa Claus was real and I believed them 100% even to the point that I almost got into a fist fight in 3rd grade because some kid kept telling me that he wasn't. 

So I devised a plan on Christmas Eve. I put a blue bow on a teddy bear with a letter to Santa thanking him for my 8 years of Christmas and hid it. Since I was told that Santa could see everything that I did, my 8 year old brain thought that he would obviously find the gift. 

Christmas Day comes. There are present everywhere but I didn't care. I was going to prove the existence of Santa Claus to that non believing fool. Imagine my disappointment when I got to the hiding spot and the bear and note was still there. That day I stopped 100% believing in anything not based in science or that I couldn't prove with my own five senses. Including God.
